doc.description: Forwards rigid body positions and orientations from NatNet to Matlab/Simulink over UDP, and forwards the commands received from Simulink over Ivy.
doc.usage: usage: matlab2pprz.py [-h] [-ac rigid_id ac_id udp_out] [-b IVY_BUS] [-ns NATNET_SERVER] [-m MULTICAST] [-dp DATA_PORT] [-cp COMMAND_PORT] [-ss SIMULINK_SERVER] [-sp SIMULINK_IN_PORT] [-v]

option.description: tuple of rigid body, A/C id and UDP output port to Simulink (multiple possible) (default: None)
Ivy bus address and port (default: None)
NatNet server data socket UDP port (default: 1511)
NatNet server command socket UDP port (default: 1510)
